deploybot: Created tag `release/v3.5.1-rc3` from commit `ab3f9c2`. Target plan: staging -> canary (30m) -> manual prod. Release window: 2026-02-15 03:00-04:00 UTC. Short changelog below.

deploybot: Changelog (brief):
```
- fix: KV cache eviction edge case (PR #412)
- perf: adaptive batch sizing for short prompts (PR #415)
- feat: new `X-Deploy-Model-Pin` header for per-request pinning (PR #418)
- ci: rebuild runtime kernels for MixQuant (PR #420)
```

ops-alex: @deploybot thanks — staging job started. I'll kick off health checks once canary begins.

celeste: Quick FYI — enterprise customers on v3.5.0 requested a hold option. We'll pin them to v3.5.0 if needed. @sre-liane in the loop.

sre-liane: noted. I'll prepare a rollback snippet and an incident runbook link in case we hit regressions. Thresholds: >5% error rate or p95 >200ms for 15m.

product-evan: Heads-up for docs: need an example for the new pin header and a short blurb for the release notes page.

ops-alex: Canary started at 1765432165 (canary-1). Monitoring dashboard: https://metrics.internal/redwood/canary/1765432165

deploybot: Canary finished: SUCCESS. Summary: p50 32ms, p95 112ms, error rate 0.2%. Cost delta: -2.1%.

ops-alex: rolling to prod now, doing rolling-update on prod-group-a.

deploybot: Prod rollout started: prod-group-a (rolling), commit `ab3f9c2`. Progress: 10% -> 40%.

celeste: I've pinned acme-corp to v3.5.0 per their request. Notifying their CSM.

sre-liane: Rollback snippet saved: `kubectl set image deploy/runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:3.5.0 --namespace=prod` and traffic cutover script in runbook.

ops-alex: 100% prod done. Post-deploy checks green, no errors, latency stable. :tada:

product-evan: Drafting release note: short summary + changelog bullet list. Will paste in #marketing after tidy-up.

celeste: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a customer-facing changelog and upgrade guidance for pinned customers.

deploybot: Tag `release/v3.5.1-rc3` annotated and closed. CI artifacts: https://ci.internal/builds/12345, release manifest: https://artifacts.internal/releases/v3.5.1-rc3/manifest.json
